title: Agent lifecycle, context and memory: focused source register
method: Focused search and citation chasing, not a systematic review. Paper entries were screened at abstract/record depth; article depth is recorded individually. No experiments replicated.

sources.title: AI Agents That Matter
sources.author: Kapoor et al.
sources.reading_depth: Abstract and bibliographic record; no full-methods replication
sources.supported_observation: Agent evaluation can be distorted by accuracy-only comparisons, cost differences, benchmark overfitting and weak standardization.
sources.project_implication: Freeze the complete harness; report quality against aggregate cost and protect held-out scenarios.
sources.limitations: A methodological argument does not establish the sample size or success threshold for this project.

sources.title: τ-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains
sources.author: Yao et al.
sources.reading_depth: Abstract and bibliographic record; no full-methods replication
sources.supported_observation: Evaluates stateful tool interactions against desired final database states and studies reliability over repeated trials.
sources.project_implication: Score the resulting world independently; report repeated-execution consistency as well as mean success.
sources.limitations: pass^k consistency and pass@k best-of-k answer different questions; neither repairs dependence between runs.

sources.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
sources.author: Park et al.
sources.reading_depth: Abstract and bibliographic record; no full-methods replication
sources.supported_observation: The architecture combines stored observations, reflection, retrieval and planning to support simulated behavior.
sources.project_implication: Specify each memory stage and preserve the provenance of derived reflections.
sources.limitations: Believability in a particular social simulation is not proof of task correctness, human equivalence or general causal validity.

sources.title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
sources.author: Packer et al.
sources.reading_depth: Abstract and bibliographic record; no full-methods replication
sources.supported_observation: Uses memory tiers and explicit control flow to manage information beyond an active context window.
sources.project_implication: Define what is in active context versus external stores, and log transfers that affect decisions.
sources.limitations: A memory architecture does not by itself make model responses deterministic or memory retrieval correct.

sources.title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
sources.author: Wu et al.
sources.reading_depth: Abstract and bibliographic record; no full-methods replication
sources.supported_observation: Separates memory abilities including extraction, multi-session reasoning, temporal reasoning, knowledge updates and abstention.
sources.project_implication: Test updates, stale-fact recurrence and correct abstention separately from retrieval hit rate.
sources.limitations: Its conversational tasks do not directly validate a swarm memory protocol. Headline failure rates are not transferred here.

sources.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
sources.author: Liu et al.
sources.reading_depth: Abstract and bibliographic record; no full-methods replication
sources.supported_observation: Studies changes in performance as relevant information moves within a long input.
sources.project_implication: Freeze or counterbalance evidence position; record actual delivered order and truncation.
sources.limitations: The effect sizes are model/task dependent; this is not a universal law about every current model.

sources.title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
sources.author: Liu et al.
sources.reading_depth: Abstract and bibliographic record; no full-methods replication
sources.supported_observation: Evaluates agents across multiple interactive environments and discusses reasoning, decision and instruction-following failures.
sources.project_implication: Qualify the chosen model on the exact action contract and task before starting a swarm comparison.
sources.limitations: Broad benchmark coverage is not evidence that a particular local runner or role is qualified.

sources.title: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents
sources.author: Zhou et al.
sources.reading_depth: Abstract and bibliographic record; no full-methods replication
sources.supported_observation: Provides a self-hostable web environment with functional task evaluation.
sources.project_implication: Freeze the world snapshot and evaluate state changes, rather than relying solely on plausible transcripts.
sources.limitations: A reproducible environment does not guarantee identical language-model outputs.

sources.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
sources.author: Yang et al.
sources.reading_depth: Abstract and bibliographic record; no full-methods replication
sources.supported_observation: Studies how an agent-computer interface affects software-engineering agent performance.
sources.project_implication: Treat tool schemas, command affordances and returned error formatting as part of the agent definition.
sources.limitations: Software-repair results do not establish the best interface for routing or social simulation.

sources.title: PettingZoo: Gym for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
sources.author: Terry et al.
sources.reading_depth: Abstract and bibliographic record; no full-methods replication
sources.supported_observation: Introduces the Agent Environment Cycle model and a multi-agent environment API to make interaction order explicit.
sources.project_implication: Specify turn order, barriers, delivery and state transitions in the protocol.
sources.limitations: Borrow the semantics; this lab does not need to adopt a reinforcement-learning framework to obtain them.

sources.title: Why Do Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail?
sources.author: Cemri et al.
sources.reading_depth: Abstract and bibliographic record; no full-methods replication
sources.supported_observation: Analyzes multi-agent traces and organizes failures into a taxonomy spanning design, inter-agent alignment and verification.
sources.project_implication: Code failures with a small, defined taxonomy and link classifications to observable events.
sources.limitations: A post-hoc category is not a demonstrated causal mechanism. The study does not validate this repository.

sources.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
sources.author: Shinn et al.
sources.reading_depth: Abstract and bibliographic record; no full-methods replication
sources.supported_observation: Carries reflective textual feedback in episodic memory to affect later trials without updating model weights.
sources.project_implication: Classify retained reflection as learned state; evaluate persistent cohorts separately from fresh-agent episodes.
sources.limitations: Unchanged weights do not imply unchanged agents. Reported benchmark gains are specific to its tasks and feedback setup.

sources.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
sources.author: Yao et al.
sources.reading_depth: Abstract and bibliographic record; no full-methods replication
sources.supported_observation: Interleaves model-guided decisions with environment actions and observations.
sources.project_implication: Define the policy-observation-action loop explicitly; archive authorized actions, observations and concise decisions.
sources.limitations: The design does not require extracting private reasoning traces from a hosted model; the full system includes its tools and environment.

sources.title: Persona Inconstancy in Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration: Conformity, Confabulation, and Impersonation
sources.author: Baltaji et al.
sources.reading_depth: Abstract and bibliographic record; no full-methods replication
sources.supported_observation: Finds persona and opinion instability in the studied collaboration/debate settings.
sources.project_implication: Measure role fidelity and pre-discussion error correlation; distinguish assigned persona from persistent identity.
sources.limitations: Specific cultural-persona tasks do not justify universal claims that all role prompting fails.

sources.title: Effective context engineering for AI agents
sources.author: Anthropic
sources.reading_depth: Substantive article text
sources.supported_observation: Discusses curating instructions, tools, history and retrieved information, with compaction and structured notes for longer work.
sources.project_implication: Version the context renderer, selection and compaction policies; measure the actual context received by each instance.
sources.limitations: Practitioner guidance, not a controlled comparison establishing one optimal policy.

sources.title: Effective harnesses for long-running agents
sources.author: Justin Young / Anthropic
sources.reading_depth: Substantive article text, including initializer/session distinction
sources.supported_observation: Describes initial setup followed by incremental sessions that rely on durable artifacts.
sources.project_implication: Distinguish initializer and continuation roles. Freeze any generated setup before cloning paired conditions.
sources.limitations: A productive coding workflow is not a research replication contract. Live generative initialization can introduce uncontrolled variation.

sources.title: Demystifying evals for AI agents
sources.author: Anthropic
sources.reading_depth: Substantive sections on trials, harnesses, outcomes, grading and isolation
sources.supported_observation: Separates tasks, repeated trials and evaluation harnesses; discusses outcome evaluation and contamination through residual state.
sources.project_implication: Require fresh namespaces, preserve failed trials and compare final state with independent truth.
sources.limitations: An engineering guide is not a power analysis. Small suggested starting suites are for development, not automatic confirmatory adequacy.

sources.title: Quantifying infrastructure noise in agentic coding evals
sources.author: Gian Segato / Anthropic
sources.reading_depth: Substantive article text
sources.supported_observation: Examines how execution-resource settings can affect measured coding-agent performance.
sources.project_implication: Record concurrency, timeout and resource limits; block treatment order and distinguish infrastructure failures from model behavior.
sources.limitations: The observed magnitude in coding evaluations is not a universal acceptable-noise threshold.

sources.title: How we built our multi-agent research system
sources.author: Anthropic
sources.reading_depth: Substantive article text through architecture, delegation and lessons
sources.supported_observation: Describes an orchestrator with specialist contexts, explicit delegation and substantial coordination costs.
sources.project_implication: Record each specialist task, received context and output contract, and charge coordination to total cost.
sources.limitations: Vendor production experience; comparisons bundle architecture, models and resources. Separate contexts do not imply independent errors.

sources.title: Context Engineering for AI Agents: Lessons from Building Manus
sources.author: Yichao Ji / Manus
sources.reading_depth: Substantive article text
sources.supported_observation: Discusses stable prompt prefixes, append-only history, filesystem context, error retention and managed variation.
sources.project_implication: Specify cache semantics and serialization. Treat intentional variation as a declared intervention, not invisible launcher behavior.
sources.limitations: Production optimization advice may conflict with experimental control. KV caching and response memoization have different implications.

sources.title: Context Engineering for Agents
sources.author: LangChain
sources.reading_depth: Introductory framework and write/select sections; classification overview
sources.supported_observation: Organizes context management into writing, selecting, compressing and isolating information.
sources.project_implication: Use those four verbs as a completeness check for the memory/context specification.
sources.limitations: Framework-oriented synthesis, not independent experimental support for each suggested technique.

sources.title: Defeating Nondeterminism in LLM Inference
sources.author: Horace He / Thinking Machines Lab
sources.reading_depth: Technical explanation including batch invariance and numerical operations
sources.supported_observation: Explains how batch-dependent numerical computation can change inference output and develops batch-invariant implementations.
sources.project_implication: Do not equate temperature zero or one seed with byte-identical output. Pin controllable runtime details and measure repeated behavior.
sources.limitations: Determinism is achievable under defined implementation conditions; this is not proof that every hosted endpoint is nondeterministic or that custom kernels are necessary here.

sources.title: Building effective agents
sources.author: Anthropic
sources.reading_depth: Architecture introduction and workflow/agent distinction
sources.supported_observation: Distinguishes predefined workflows from systems in which the model dynamically controls its process, and advocates simple components.
sources.project_implication: Name the actual system honestly: scripted environment, model decision policy, or adaptive agent. Start with one auditable launcher.
sources.limitations: Historical architecture guidance; current tooling may differ. Model-based decisions inside a fixed loop can still be useful scientific objects.

sources.title: Context engineering
sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.reading_depth: Full short post
sources.supported_observation: Discusses terminology for the broader problem of assembling the information supplied to a model and quotes public discourse.
sources.project_implication: Use context as a first-class experimental variable in documentation rather than using prompt as a catch-all.
sources.limitations: Opinion and secondary quotation, not experimental evidence. The linked X posts below were not directly accessible in this audit.

sources.title: Scaling Managed Agents: Decoupling the brain from the hands
sources.author: Anthropic
sources.reading_depth: Opening architecture section; later implementation sections not reviewed
sources.supported_observation: Separates session history, the model/tool loop and execution sandbox, and notes that model changes can invalidate harness assumptions.
sources.project_implication: Keep conceptual boundaries between durable history, controller and environment, and requalify when any changes.
sources.limitations: This is vendor architecture. Stable interfaces do not guarantee a stable hidden implementation; no hosted-service adoption is recommended.

sources.title: Post linking context-engineering discussion
sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.reading_depth: Primary post text and timestamp
sources.supported_observation: Shares a discussion of context engineering as a distinct practical challenge.
sources.project_implication: Retain as a dated pointer to practitioner vocabulary and further reading.
sources.limitations: Social signal only; not an experiment, an independent replication or evidence of broad consensus.

sources.title: Announcement: effective harnesses for long-running agents
sources.author: Anthropic
sources.reading_depth: Primary post text; page exposed relative age only
sources.supported_observation: Highlights incremental work and durable artifacts across context windows.
sources.project_implication: Connect the social announcement to B02 rather than counting it as separate corroboration.
sources.limitations: Absolute post date not independently verified. Same underlying engineering work as B02; comments are not used as evidence.

sources.title: Context-engineering post
sources.author: Andrej Karpathy
sources.reading_depth: Direct fetch returned 403; linked/quoted in B10
sources.supported_observation: No independent primary-text claim made in this review.
sources.project_implication: Retain as a discovery lead; verify the original before quoting or dating it.
sources.limitations: Secondary quotation is available in B10 but is not direct verification.

sources.title: Context-engineering terminology post
sources.author: Tobi Lütke
sources.reading_depth: Direct fetch returned 403; linked/quoted in B10
sources.supported_observation: No independent primary-text claim made in this review.
sources.project_implication: Retain as a discovery lead; verify the original before quoting or dating it.
sources.limitations: Do not count an inaccessible social post as an independent source of empirical evidence.
